sections.heading: Overview
bullets: No invulnerable split phase — Gorseval is a straight burn with a hard 7-minute enrage and a signature glide-or-burst mechanic.

sections.heading: Key mechanics
bullets: Spectral Darkness: orbs spawn and leave expanding damage fields — pop them for a cleanse orb if you're stacking the debuff.
World Eater (~66%, ~33%, ~0%): a slow cast that kills the whole squad if it finishes. Either burst Gorseval down first, or glide clear using the 4 updrafts.
Updrafts vanish ~15s after someone stands near one — don't burn them early, you'll need them for the next World Eater.
Ghastly Rampage: ground circles that detonate after 3s and stack heavy vulnerability — breaking the defiance bar cuts this short.
Melee swings target the highest-toughness player in the squad — don't stack toughness on DPS.
